title: Page 1
content_zh:
自远古尧舜以降，上自皇族贵胄，下至贩夫走卒，“吃”，无疑是众人心中大事。可会吃不代表懂吃，尤其擅长割烹、刀火超群的名厨，更是少之又少。
当时盛传一段顺口溜——
“北吃前门‘一条龙’，南至河畔‘小莲庄’”。
凡举开席宴客，若不进“一条龙”或“小莲庄”，旁人一定会笑称白吃了一顿；在当时，无人不把“一条龙”跟“小莲庄”，视作天馔美食的象征……
第1章(1)
江南扬州城
段柯古穿过卖簸箕、看相算卦的摊子，眼前一切和他住惯的长安城有些相似，可细瞧，又处处显得不同。尤其是小吃摊，这儿没有他吃惯的油茶豆汁驴打滚，却多了不少卖笋干梅菜汤团的小摊。
“这位爷，歇会儿吃些面点吧？”殷实小贩哈著腰问。
段柯古摸摸肚子，还真有些饿了，只是眺眺摊上，他笑了笑走开。不是他瞧不起路边小摊，而是眼前吃食诱不出他肚里馋虫。
今年二十有七的段柯古出身名门，他爹段文昌是当今丞相，他不久前也才受封为江州刺史。从小丰衣足食、鲜食美馔伺候的结果，就是养出他爱吃挑吃的习性。
寻望了眼，长长一条街数十摊子，竟没一家能让他解开银囊坐下朵颐的。
他瞧了瞧天色，这会儿该也过了申时一刻，暗叹：“难不成真得这个时间上‘小莲庄’？”
说来，他前往江州赴任时限，还有十多天时间。他所以赶著下江南，就是为了一尝“小莲庄”厨子的手艺。若“小莲庄”厨子的手艺名副其实，这会儿过去一定吃不到什么好东西。可不到那儿，他一时又想不出能上哪儿用膳……
正当踌躇，远远飘来一股肉香。段柯古吸著鼻子迈步接近，顺著一旁小巷走到底，只见一家蓬户茅庐前头，排排行列了十几二十个客人。
“请问这位大哥，”段柯古打了个揖。“你们在等些什么？”
大汉瞧他身上包袱，再听他口音，问了句：“你是外地人？”
“是，小弟初次造访扬州，就突然嗅到这儿有股香气……”
“算你识货。”大汉一拍他肩膀。“咱们这列人全都在等如意姑娘的煎肉饼，她每天就只做九十枚，卖完就没了，我今天来得算晚，还真怕买不到……”
随著大汉解释，人龙慢慢往前行进。段柯古一瞧买著煎肉饼的客人个个一脸喜获至宝、笑逐颜开，也不自觉站在人龙最后，想试试这肉饼滋味，是否真如他闻起来那般好。
轮到段柯古前头的大汉，他看著大汉往窗里探。

“大娘，我要三枚。”
“三枚，马上来，您小心烫。”
说话的，是一名穿著灰色襦裙的妇人，她正铲起三枚煎肉饼包起。
大汉接走离开，段柯古朝她颔首。
“麻烦，我一枚。”
“您稍等会儿。”妇人温婉一笑，然后转身跟里边人喊：“如意，再送肉饼过来。”
“里边早没了。”一道清脆声音传来。“外边还有人吗？”
妇人转头，眼神与段柯古对上，她尴尬陪笑：“真是对不起，小店做的肉饼，刚才都包给前一位客人了。”
望著余香犹存的小铺，段柯古表情失望至极。
他回头望望巷子前头开始收拾整理的小吃摊，知道这会儿连上“小莲庄”吃一顿的时间，也被他给浪费掉了。
但怎好意思怪罪这么温和有礼的店家，他叹口气笑道：“我初来扬州，一时不知该上哪儿打牙祭，正好嗅到贵店的煎肉饼香气，怎知就碰巧晚了一步。”
段柯古这么一说，妇人越发觉得抱歉。“真是，让您白花这么多时间却没买著饼……不如这样，公子不嫌弃的话，我去问我女儿能不能做点什么，就当帮您接风洗尘？”
“这怎么好意思。”
“人说出外靠朋友，”妇人边说边从大门绕出来，招手要他进来坐下。“您头回进扬州就到咱小店，也是鄙店荣幸，来，您休息会儿，我去帮您冲杯茶。”
“大娘，您别忙……”
段柯古还没说完，妇人已从灶房拎了壶滚水来。她捻起一小撮茶叶进壶，盖起后滚水急倾，不一会儿茶香四溢。动作之流畅爽利，就算见多识广如段柯古，也暗暗赞了声好。
“您试试。”妇人将滚滚热茶送上。
段柯古正要言谢，就在这时，一名年轻女子突然自灶房步出。
“娘。”
他认出这声音，就是刚才在里边回话的姑娘。他朝她一眺，一时间眩晕了眼，好标致的姑娘！

来人就像道光射进昏暗的茅庐，虽然穿的不过是寻常的灰蓝布衣，但举手投足，就是有一股他人没有的雍容气度。青乌乌的发上只用一条红线系紧，秀雅的面容脂粉未施，却显得她雪肌嫩里透红、吹弹可破。一双黑瞳如星熠熠发亮，红唇微勾。
要不是亲眼所见，段柯古绝对没法相信，如此佳丽，竟会出自一家煎肉饼店！
“你、你好。”
“小女子见过公子。”曲如意轻回了个礼。
不只他一双眼黏在她身上，曲如意也一样机警地看著他。
瞧他眼神清朗，她想，娘说得没错，这人应该跟陆明那帮人没有关系。
为方便赶路，段柯古只穿上一身玄黑劲装，但就算如此，仍旧掩不住他端整的容貌与一副八尺宽肩的好身材。
曲母拉著女儿手介绍：“这位就是我跟你提过的客人。他初进扬州，又在咱们店前等了许久，就卖娘一个面子，你去灶房看有没有什么可以做给他吃的，嗯？”
娘这舍不得见人肚子饿的性子，还是跟以前一样。如意皱眉。都说过多少次了，她俩已不再是“小莲庄”的当家夫人跟小姐，不能再动不动放人进来吃饭了。
发觉女儿表情不悦，曲母又摇摇她手，嘴里无声地央求。
如意叹口气。“好吧，我去瞧瞧。”
直到她身影消失在灶房那端，段柯古才想起还没介绍自己。他怎么这么失礼！赶忙起身一揖。“晚辈姓段，名柯古，不知大娘如何称呼？”
曲母不是没发现段柯古的反应，掩嘴低笑道：“先夫姓曲，外边人都喊我曲大娘。至于那个……”她朝灶房一瞟。“是我女儿，闺名如意。”
曲如意……段柯古喃喃念了两回。好个玲珑剔透的名字，当真人如其名，适配极了。
如意又走了出来。
“里边只剩做肉饼的馅料，勉强可以做道炒饭，”她往他一瞟。“就不知公子愿不愿意凑合？”
段柯古一愣，突然不知该答应还是要拒绝。绝不是他不知好歹，而是他在长安城，最喜欢就是“一条龙”饭庄的芙蓉炒饭，胃口早被养刁的情况下，就怕凑合之下的炒饭不尽完美，他食之无味就算，还损了大娘一番美意。
如意心神剔透，瞧出段柯古心头犹豫。她冷冷回道：“既然公子瞧不起，我也不勉强。”
“如意……”
见曲母为难，段柯古忙说话。“不是这么回事。是在下觉得不好意思，想姑娘好不容易可以歇息，在下却杵在这儿叨扰……”

她直视他眼。“不是瞧不起就好。来者是客，您就安心坐著吧。”
“是啊是啊！公子就安心坐著，其他就交给如意。”曲母边说，边推著女儿走进灶房。
段柯古挲挲下颚，心里已做出最坏打算，不管等会儿端来的炒饭多难下咽，他也要吃得一干二净。
content_en:
Since the time of Yao and Shun in ancient times, "eating" has undoubtedly been a major concern for everyone, from the royal family and nobles to the peddlers and foot soldiers. But knowing how to eat doesn't mean you know how to eat. There are very few famous chefs who are good at kappo and have excellent knife skills.
There was a popular jingle at that time——
"Eat the 'Yilong' at Qianmen in the north and 'Xiaolianzhuang' by the river in the south."
Whenever you have a banquet, if you don't enter "Yilong" or "Xiaolianzhuang", others will laugh and say that your meal is in vain; at that time, everyone regarded "Yilong" and "Xiaolianzhuang" as symbols of heavenly delicacies...
Chapter 1(1)
Jiangnan Yangzhou City
Duan Kegu passed by stalls selling dustpans and fortune telling. Everything in front of him was somewhat similar to the Chang'an City where he was used to living, but upon closer inspection, everything seemed different. Especially the food stalls. There is no tea-oiled bean sauce and donkey rolling here that he is used to, but there are many stalls selling dumplings with dried bamboo shoots, plums and vegetables.
"Sir, would you like to have some noodles for a while?" the honest hawker asked, bowing his waist.
Duan Kegu felt his stomach and felt a little hungry. He just looked at the stall, smiled and walked away. It's not that he looks down on roadside stalls, but the food in front of him doesn't seduce his greed.
Duan Kegu, who is twenty-seven this year, comes from a well-known family. His father Duan Wenchang is the current prime minister. He was also named the governor of Jiangzhou not long ago. As a result of having plenty of food and clothing and being served delicious food since he was young, he developed the habit of being picky about food.
After looking around, there were dozens of stalls in a long street, but none of them allowed him to unpack his money bag and sit down to eat.
He looked at the sky and saw that it was past midnight, and sighed to himself: "Is it possible that we really have to go to Xiaolianzhuang at this time?"
It seems that there are still more than ten days before he can go to Jiangzhou to take up his post. The reason why he rushed to Jiangnan was to try the skills of the cooks at "Xiaolianzhuang". If the chef's skills at "Xiaolianzhuang" were worthy of the name, he would not be able to eat anything good in the past. But without getting there, he couldn't think of where to eat...
Just as he was hesitating, a smell of meat came from afar. Duan Kegu sniffed and stepped closer, walking along the alley to the end, and saw a dozen or twenty guests lined up in front of a thatched cottage.
"Excuse me, big brother," Duan Kegu bowed. "What are you waiting for?"
The big man looked at the baggage on his body, listened to his accent, and asked, "Are you a foreigner?"
"Yes, when I visited Yangzhou for the first time, I suddenly smelled the aroma here..."
"You know the stuff." The big man patted him on the shoulder. "We are all waiting for Miss Ruyi's pancakes. She only makes ninety pieces every day, and they are gone when they are sold out. I came late today, and I was really afraid that I wouldn't be able to buy them..."
As the big man explained, the people and the dragon slowly moved forward. When Duan Kegu looked at the customers buying fried meat cakes, all of them looked happy and smiling, he unknowingly stood at the end of the queue, wanting to test whether the meat cakes tasted as good as he smelled.
It was the turn of the big man in front of Duan Kegu. He watched the big man leaning into the window.
"Mom, I want three."
"Three pieces, come right away, please be careful of burning them."
The speaker was a woman wearing a gray skirt. She was scooping up three fried meatloaf and wrapping them.
The big man picked her up and left, and Duan Kegu nodded to her.
"Trouble, I have one."
"Wait a moment." The woman smiled gently, then turned around and shouted to the people inside: "If you wish, I'll bring you some more meat pie."
"It's gone inside already." A clear voice came. "Is there anyone else outside?"
The woman turned her head and met Duan Kegu's eyes. She smiled awkwardly and said, "I'm really sorry. The meat pies made in the shop were all reserved for the previous customer."
Looking at the shop where the fragrance still lingered, Duan Kegu looked extremely disappointed.
He looked back at the food stalls at the front of the alley that had started to be tidied up, knowing that the time he had spent to have a meal at "Xiaolianzhuang" had also been wasted by him.
But how dare he blame such a gentle and polite shopkeeper? He sighed and said with a smile: "I first came to Yangzhou."Zhouzhou, I didn’t know where to go to have a tooth ceremony, and I happened to smell the aroma of fried meat cakes in your store, but I happened to be a step too late. "
When Duan Kegu said this, the woman felt even more sorry. "Really, you have wasted so much time without buying cakes... How about this, if you don't mind it, sir, I will ask my daughter if she can do something, just to help you clean up the dust? "
"How embarrassing. "
"People say you rely on friends when you go out," the woman said as she walked around the door and waved for him to come in and sit down. "It's an honor for you to come to our store for the first time when you come to Yangzhou. Come on, take a rest and I'll make you a cup of tea. "
"Auntie, please don't be busy..."
Before Duan Kegu finished speaking, the woman had already brought a pot of boiling water from the kitchen. She twisted a handful of tea leaves into the pot, covered it and poured the boiling water in. Soon the aroma of tea overflowed. The movements were so smooth and crisp that even a well-informed Duan Kegu would secretly praise him.
"You try. "The woman brought boiling hot tea.
Duan Kegu was about to say thank you, when a young woman suddenly walked out of the kitchen.
"Mother. "
He recognized the voice as the girl who had just answered inside. He looked at her and was dizzy for a moment, what a beautiful girl!
The visitor was like a beam of light shining into the dim thatched cottage. Although he was wearing ordinary gray and blue cloth, his gestures and movements showed a grace that no one else had. Her black hair was tied with only a red thread, and her elegant face had no makeup, but her skin was so tender and rosy that it could be broken by a blow. A pair of black pupils are as bright as stars, and the red lips are slightly hooked.
If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, Duan Kegu would never have believed that such a beauty could come from a pancake shop!
“H-hello. "
"The little girl has met the young master. "Qu Ruyi returned the salute lightly.
Not only was his eyes glued to her, Qu Ruyi also looked at him alertly.
Seeing his clear eyes, she thought, her mother was right, this man should have nothing to do with Lu Ming's gang.
To facilitate his journey, Duan Kegu only wore a black outfit, but even so, he still couldn't hide his neat appearance and good figure with eight-foot broad shoulders.
Qu’s mother took her daughter’s hand and introduced: “This is the guest I mentioned to you. He first came to Yangzhou and waited in front of our store for a long time. Just to show off his face, you go to the kitchen to see if there is anything you can cook for him, okay? "
My mother's temperament of not wanting to see people hungry is still the same as before. Ruyi frowned. I have said it many times that they are no longer the head wife and young lady of "Xiaolianzhuang", and they can no longer let people in for dinner.
Realizing that her daughter's expression was unhappy, Qu's mother shook her hand again and begged silently.
Ruyi sighed. "Okay, I'll go take a look. "
It wasn't until her figure disappeared at the other end of the kitchen that Duan Kegu remembered that he hadn't introduced himself yet. Why is he so rude! He quickly stood up and bowed. "This junior's surname is Duan and his first name is Kegu. I wonder what I call my aunt? "
It was not that Qu’s mother didn’t notice Duan Kegu’s reaction, she covered her mouth and smiled softly: “My late husband’s surname is Qu, and people outside call me Aunt Qu. As for that..." She glanced towards the kitchen. "That's my daughter, her maiden name is Ruyi. "
Qu Ruyi... Duan Kegu muttered it twice. What an exquisite and clear name, it fits the person perfectly.
Ruyi walked out again.
"There's only the stuffing left in it to make meatloaf, which is barely enough to make fried rice," she glanced at him. "I wonder if the young master is willing to improvise? "
Duan Kegu was stunned, suddenly not knowing whether to agree or refuse. It's not that he is ungrateful, but that his favorite thing in Chang'an City is the hibiscus fried rice from the "One-stop" restaurant. Since his appetite has been cultivated for a long time, he is afraid that the fried rice he makes is not perfect. Even if he eats it tasteless, it will ruin the aunt's good taste.
Ruyi's mind was clear and he could see Duan Kegu's hesitation. She replied coldly: "Since the young master looks down on you, I won't force you. "
"As you wish..."
See Qu's mother in trouble, Duan Kegu was busy talking. "That's not the case. It's just that I feel embarrassed. I want the girl to finally have a rest, but I'm here to bother you..."
She looked him straight in the eye. "It's not just a matter of looking down on me. You are a guest, so just sit back and relax."
"Yes, yes! Master, just sit back and relax, and leave the rest to Ruyi." Qu's mother said, pushing her daughter into the kitchen.
Duan Kegu rubbed his chin, already preparing for the worst. No matter how hard it was to swallow the fried rice that would be served later, he would eat it all.
